Gbaya people have been present in Central Africa since at least the 16th century. What is the agriculture method of Gbaya? The agriculture method of Gbaya is called "swidden", a type of "slash and burn" farming where the forest is cleared, vegetation burnt on top of the cleared land, the farm used for a few years, then abandoned and the families move to a new area.
